extends SceneTree
## Shared headless test helpers: frame stepping, key injection, PASS/FAIL bookkeeping.
## Tests drive the logic layer only (LoopState, Story, Controls, SoundBank autoloads);
## no presentation scene is needed. Run:  "$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/<file>.gd

var ls: Node          # LoopState: clock, flags, timeline
var story: Node       # Story: dialogue, interaction latch, Hari's state
var sound: Node       # SoundBank: trigger_counts
var checks := 0
var failures := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run_and_report")

func _run_and_report() -> void:
	await process_frame
	ls = root.get_node_or_null("LoopState")
	story = root.get_node_or_null("Story")
	sound = root.get_node_or_null("SoundBank")
	check("autoloads present", ls != null and story != null and sound != null and root.has_node("Controls"), "%s %s %s" % [ls, story, sound])
	# run() returns true only if it reached its end; a script error makes it return null.
	var completed: Variant = false
	if ls and story and sound:
		completed = await run()
	check("test script ran to completion", completed == true, completed)
	print("")
	var verdict := "PASS"
	if failures > 0:
		verdict = "FAIL"
	print("%s: %d checks, %d failed -> %s" % [get_script().resource_path.get_file(), checks, failures, verdict])
	quit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)

func run() -> bool:
	return true

func check(id: String, passed: bool, observed: Variant = "") -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not passed:
		failures += 1
	print("[%s] %s   %s" % ["PASS" if passed else "FAIL", id, str(observed)])

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

func key(code: Key, pressed: bool, echo := false) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	event.echo = echo
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key, hold_frames := 1) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await steps(hold_frames)
	key(code, false)
	await steps(1)

## 10 presses in 20 frames (~0.33 s): faster than any line or cooldown guard.
func mash(code: Key, presses := 10) -> void:
	for i in presses:
		key(code, true)
		await steps(1)
		key(code, false)
		await steps(1)

## Wait (real frames) until cond is true or `seconds` pass. Returns cond's final value.
func wait_until(cond: Callable, seconds: float) -> bool:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(seconds * 1000.0)
	while not cond.call() and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await steps(1)
	return cond.call()

## Advance any open dialogue with spaced E taps until it closes, then wait out any brief
## state (NOTES/KEYS/STARTLED) and the talk cooldown.
func finish_dialogue(max_taps := 20) -> void:
	for i in max_taps:
		if not story.dialogue_active:
			break
		await steps(10)     # past the per-line minimum display time
		await tap(KEY_E)
	await wait_until(func() -> bool: return not story.flash_active(), 5.0)
	await steps(30)         # a player takes longer than the 0.35 s talk cooldown to press again

## The presentation's side of the thin interface, stood in for by the test.
func stand_near(target: String, x := 4.5) -> void:
	story.nearby_target = target
	story.player_x = x

2	## A5 materials audit (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §1.3, §2.1-2.5; see godot/MATERIALS.md).
3	## Headless-only: parses the shader source, loads every .tres through the resource loader, loads the slice and hint
4	## scenes, and asserts every row of MATERIALS.md. For each normal map it also reads the raw PNG bytes and prints
5	## curl_ratio under both conventions, using the course helper in godot/tests/normal_map_check.gd.
6	## Run:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60
7	## Headless draws nothing: this proves wiring, uniform contracts, texture paths and .import flags, never the look.
8	
9	const NormalCheck = preload("res://tests/normal_map_check.gd")
10	
11	const DECK_SHADER := "res://shaders/deck_marble.gdshader"
12	const HINT_SHADER := "res://shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader"
13	const NIGHT_SHADER := "res://shaders/night_skip.gdshader"
14	
15	const MARBLE_DRY := "res://materials/marble_dry.tres"
16	const MARBLE_WET := "res://materials/marble_wet.tres"
17	const HINT_A := "res://materials/hint_a_source_color.tres"
18	const HINT_B := "res://materials/hint_b_no_hint.tres"
19	const NIGHT_MAT := "res://materials/night_skip.tres"
20	
21	const DIFF := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_diff_2k.png"
22	const ROUGH := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_rough_2k.png"
23	const NOR_GL := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_nor_gl_2k.png"
24	const NOR_DX := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_nor_dx_2k.png"
25	const HINT_STRIP := "res://assets/textures/hint_strip_3x1.png"
26	
27	## Each row: param -> [glsl_type, hint_text_in_source, default_in_source].
28	## Hint text is matched by substring so "source_color, filter_nearest" works regardless of surrounding whitespace.
29	const DECK_UNIFORMS := {
30		"albedo_tex":       ["sampler2D", "source_color, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable", ""],
31		"albedo_tint":      ["vec4",      "source_color",                                      "vec4(1.0)"],
32		"tile_size_m":      ["float",     "hint_range(0.25, 4.0)",                             "1.0"],
33		"roughness_tex":    ["sampler2D", "filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable",               ""],
34		"normal_tex":       ["sampler2D", "hint_normal, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable",  ""],
35		"roughness_scale":  ["float",     "hint_range(0.0, 2.0)",                              "1.0"],
36		"specular_amount":  ["float",     "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)",                              "0.5"],
37		"normal_depth":     ["float",     "hint_range(0.0, 2.0)",                              "1.0"],
38	}
39	const HINT_UNIFORMS := {
40		"strip_as_colour":    ["sampler2D", "source_color, filter_nearest", ""],
41		"strip_as_data":      ["sampler2D", "filter_nearest",               ""],
42		"use_source_color":   ["bool",      "",                             "false"],
43	}
44	const NIGHT_UNIFORMS := {
45		"skip_amount":    ["float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)",             "0.0"],
46		"skip_tint":      ["vec4",  "source_color",                     "vec4(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)"],
47		"tint_strength": ["float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)",              "0.5"],
48	}

50	## get_shader_uniform_list() returns these Variant types for each uniform.
51	const UNIFORM_LIST_TYPES := {
52		# deck_marble
53		"albedo_tex":        TYPE_OBJECT,  # sampler2D exposed as Texture
54		"albedo_tint":       TYPE_COLOR,
55		"tile_size_m":       TYPE_FLOAT,

57		"normal_tex":        TYPE_OBJECT,

117	# ---- shader source and uniform list ----------------------------------------------------------------
118	
119	func read_source(path: String) -> String:
120		var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path)
121		check("shader source readable: %s" % path.get_file(), src != "", path)
122		return src
123	
124	func check_shader_source(path: String, expected: Dictionary) -> void:
125		var src := read_source(path)
126		if src == "":
127			return
128		# Match `uniform <type> <name> [: <hints>] [= <default>];`
129		var re := RegEx.create_from_string(
130			"uniform\\s+(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*(?::\\s*([^=;]+?)\\s*)?(?:=\\s*([^;]+?)\\s*)?;")
131		var declared := {}
132		for m in re.search_all(src):
133			declared[m.get_string(2)] = [m.get_string(1), m.get_string(3), m.get_string(4)]
134		for name in expected:
135			var want: Array = expected[name]
136			var got: Array = declared.get(name, [])
137			var ok_type: bool = got.size() == 3 and got[0] == want[0]
138			var ok_hint: bool = got.size() == 3 and (want[1] == "" or (got[1] as String).find(want[1]) != -1)
139			var ok_def: bool = got.size() == 3 and (want[2] == "" or (got[2] as String).strip_edges() == want[2])

extends "res://tests/harness.gd"
## A5 materials audit (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §1.3, §2.1-2.5; see godot/MATERIALS.md).
## Headless-only: parses the shader source, loads every .tres through the resource loader, loads the slice and hint
## scenes, and asserts every row of MATERIALS.md. For each normal map it also reads the raw PNG bytes and prints
## curl_ratio under both conventions, using the course helper in godot/tests/normal_map_check.gd.
## Run:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60
## Headless draws nothing: this proves wiring, uniform contracts, texture paths and .import flags, never the look.

const NormalCheck = preload("res://tests/normal_map_check.gd")

const DECK_SHADER := "res://shaders/deck_marble.gdshader"
const HINT_SHADER := "res://shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader"
const NIGHT_SHADER := "res://shaders/night_skip.gdshader"

const MARBLE_DRY := "res://materials/marble_dry.tres"
const MARBLE_WET := "res://materials/marble_wet.tres"
const HINT_A := "res://materials/hint_a_source_color.tres"
const HINT_B := "res://materials/hint_b_no_hint.tres"
const NIGHT_MAT := "res://materials/night_skip.tres"

const DIFF := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_diff_2k.png"
const ROUGH := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_rough_2k.png"
const NOR_GL := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_nor_gl_2k.png"
const NOR_DX := "res://assets/textures/marble_01/marble_01_nor_dx_2k.png"
const HINT_STRIP := "res://assets/textures/hint_strip_3x1.png"

## Each row: param -> [glsl_type, hint_text_in_source, default_in_source].
## Hint text is matched by substring so "source_color, filter_nearest" works regardless of surrounding whitespace.
const DECK_UNIFORMS := {
	"albedo_tex":       ["sampler2D", "source_color, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable", ""],
	"albedo_tint":      ["vec4",      "source_color",                                      "vec4(1.0)"],
	"tile_size_m":      ["float",     "hint_range(0.25, 4.0)",                             "1.0"],
	"roughness_tex":    ["sampler2D", "filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable",               ""],
	"normal_tex":       ["sampler2D", "hint_normal, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable",  ""],
	"roughness_scale":  ["float",     "hint_range(0.0, 2.0)",                              "1.0"],
	"specular_amount":  ["float",     "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)",                              "0.5"],
	"normal_depth":     ["float",     "hint_range(0.0, 2.0)",                              "1.0"],
}
const HINT_UNIFORMS := {
	"strip_as_colour":    ["sampler2D", "source_color, filter_nearest", ""],
	"strip_as_data":      ["sampler2D", "filter_nearest",               ""],
	"use_source_color":   ["bool",      "",                             "false"],
}
const NIGHT_UNIFORMS := {
	"skip_amount":    ["float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)",             "0.0"],
	"skip_tint":      ["vec4",  "source_color",                     "vec4(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)"],
	"tint_strength": ["float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)",              "0.5"],
}

## get_shader_uniform_list() returns these Variant types for each uniform.
const UNIFORM_LIST_TYPES := {
	# deck_marble
	"albedo_tex":        TYPE_OBJECT,  # sampler2D exposed as Texture
	"albedo_tint":       TYPE_COLOR,
	"tile_size_m":       TYPE_FLOAT,
	"roughness_tex":     TYPE_OBJECT,
	"normal_tex":        TYPE_OBJECT,
	"roughness_scale":   TYPE_FLOAT,
	"specular_amount":   TYPE_FLOAT,
	"normal_depth":      TYPE_FLOAT,
	# hint_experiment
	"strip_as_colour":   TYPE_OBJECT,
	"strip_as_data":     TYPE_OBJECT,
	"use_source_color":  TYPE_BOOL,
	# night_skip
	"skip_amount":       TYPE_FLOAT,
	"skip_tint":         TYPE_COLOR,
	"tint_strength":     TYPE_FLOAT,
}

## .import rows read from the .import file; mode and mipmap flags from CHANGE-BRIEF.md §2.2, §2.5.
const IMPORT_EXPECTED := {
	DIFF:       {"compress/mode": 2, "compress/normal_map": 2, "mipmaps/generate": true,  "detect_3d/compress_to": 0},
	ROUGH:      {"compress/mode": 2, "compress/normal_map": 2, "mipmaps/generate": true,  "detect_3d/compress_to": 0},
	NOR_GL:     {"compress/mode": 2, "compress/normal_map": 1, "mipmaps/generate": true,  "detect_3d/compress_to": 0},
	NOR_DX:     {"compress/mode": 0, "compress/normal_map": 2, "mipmaps/generate": false, "detect_3d/compress_to": 0},
	HINT_STRIP: {"compress/mode": 0, "compress/normal_map": 2, "mipmaps/generate": false, "detect_3d/compress_to": 0},
}

## Review fix: the imported format, measured with get_image().get_format() on this machine (macOS, desktop import).
## It confirms the enums above: compress/mode 2 gives a VRAM format, normal_map 1 gives the two-channel normal format,
## and compress/mode 0 stays uncompressed RGB8.
const FORMAT_EXPECTED := {
	DIFF:       Image.FORMAT_DXT1,
	ROUGH:      Image.FORMAT_DXT1,
	NOR_GL:     Image.FORMAT_RGTC_RG,
	NOR_DX:     Image.FORMAT_RGB8,
	HINT_STRIP: Image.FORMAT_RGB8,
}

func run() -> bool:
	check_shader_source(DECK_SHADER, DECK_UNIFORMS)
	check_shader_source(HINT_SHADER, HINT_UNIFORMS)
	check_shader_source(NIGHT_SHADER, NIGHT_UNIFORMS)

	check_uniform_list(DECK_SHADER, DECK_UNIFORMS.keys())
	check_uniform_list(HINT_SHADER, HINT_UNIFORMS.keys())
	check_uniform_list(NIGHT_SHADER, NIGHT_UNIFORMS.keys())

	check_marble_material(MARBLE_DRY, "dry", {})
	check_marble_material(MARBLE_WET, "wet", {"roughness_scale": 0.3, "specular_amount": 0.8})
	check_hint_material(HINT_A, true)
	check_hint_material(HINT_B, false)
	check_night_material()

	for path in IMPORT_EXPECTED:
		check_import(path, IMPORT_EXPECTED[path])
	for path in FORMAT_EXPECTED:
		check_format(path, FORMAT_EXPECTED[path])

	await check_scene_wiring()

	curl_report("marble_01_nor_gl", NOR_GL)
	curl_report("marble_01_nor_dx", NOR_DX)
	return true

# ---- shader source and uniform list ----------------------------------------------------------------

func read_source(path: String) -> String:
	var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path)
	check("shader source readable: %s" % path.get_file(), src != "", path)
	return src

func check_shader_source(path: String, expected: Dictionary) -> void:
	var src := read_source(path)
	if src == "":
		return
	# Match `uniform <type> <name> [: <hints>] [= <default>];`
	var re := RegEx.create_from_string(
		"uniform\\s+(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*(?::\\s*([^=;]+?)\\s*)?(?:=\\s*([^;]+?)\\s*)?;")
	var declared := {}
	for m in re.search_all(src):
		declared[m.get_string(2)] = [m.get_string(1), m.get_string(3), m.get_string(4)]
	for name in expected:
		var want: Array = expected[name]
		var got: Array = declared.get(name, [])
		var ok_type: bool = got.size() == 3 and got[0] == want[0]
		var ok_hint: bool = got.size() == 3 and (want[1] == "" or (got[1] as String).find(want[1]) != -1)
		var ok_def: bool = got.size() == 3 and (want[2] == "" or (got[2] as String).strip_edges() == want[2])
		check("source %s: %s %s declared" % [path.get_file(), want[0], name], ok_type, got)
		check("source %s: %s hints contain '%s'" % [path.get_file(), name, want[1]], ok_hint, got)
		check("source %s: %s default = %s" % [path.get_file(), name, want[2]], ok_def, got)
		# Review fix: "hints contain" is a substring match, so a data sampler that gained source_color (F6) still
		# passed it. A sampler whose expected hints lack source_color must not have it.
		if want[0] == "sampler2D" and not (want[1] as String).contains("source_color"):
			check("source %s: data sampler %s has no source_color" % [path.get_file(), name],
				got.size() == 3 and not (got[1] as String).contains("source_color"), got)

func check_uniform_list(path: String, names: Array) -> void:
	var sh: Shader = load(path)
	check("shader loads: %s" % path.get_file(), sh != null, sh)
	if sh == null:
		return
	var listed := {}
	for u in sh.get_shader_uniform_list():
		listed[u.name] = u.type
	# An empty list means the shader failed to parse; check this before per-name checks.
	check("%s uniform list is non-empty (parses)" % path.get_file(), listed.size() >= names.size(), listed)
	for name in names:
		var want: int = UNIFORM_LIST_TYPES[name]
		check("%s uniform list: %s is %s" % [path.get_file(), name, type_string(want)],
			listed.get(name, -1) == want, type_string(listed.get(name, TYPE_NIL)))

# ---- material resources ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

func check_marble_material(path: String, kind: String, overrides: Dictionary) -> void:
	var mat: ShaderMaterial = load(path)
	check("material loads: %s" % path.get_file(), mat != null, mat)
	if mat == null:
		return
	check("%s uses deck_marble.gdshader" % path.get_file(),
		mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == DECK_SHADER, mat.shader)
	# Textures: three samplers, bound to the three Marble 01 files, never to the DX normal.
	_check_texture_param(mat, &"albedo_tex", DIFF, path)
	_check_texture_param(mat, &"roughness_tex", ROUGH, path)
	_check_texture_param(mat, &"normal_tex", NOR_GL, path)
	# Overridden scalar uniforms (whatever's in the dict); everything else must stay unset so the shader defaults apply.
	var defaults := {"roughness_scale": 1.0, "specular_amount": 0.5, "normal_depth": 1.0, "tile_size_m": 1.0}
	for p in defaults:
		var set_value: Variant = mat.get_shader_parameter(p)
		if overrides.has(p):
			check("%s overrides %s = %s" % [path.get_file(), p, overrides[p]],
				set_value != null and is_equal_approx(float(set_value), overrides[p]), set_value)
		else:
			check("%s does not override %s (shader default %s applies)" % [path.get_file(), p, defaults[p]],
				set_value == null, set_value)
	# Guard: no DX normal must be bound anywhere on this material.
	for name in [&"albedo_tex", &"roughness_tex", &"normal_tex"]:
		var tex: Texture2D = mat.get_shader_parameter(name)
		if tex == null:
			continue
		check("%s %s is not the DX normal" % [path.get_file(), name],
			tex.resource_path != NOR_DX, tex.resource_path)

func check_hint_material(path: String, expected_bool: bool) -> void:
	var mat: ShaderMaterial = load(path)
	check("material loads: %s" % path.get_file(), mat != null, mat)
	if mat == null:
		return
	check("%s uses hint_experiment.gdshader" % path.get_file(),
		mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == HINT_SHADER, mat.shader)
	_check_texture_param(mat, &"strip_as_colour", HINT_STRIP, path)
	_check_texture_param(mat, &"strip_as_data", HINT_STRIP, path)
	var b: Variant = mat.get_shader_parameter(&"use_source_color")
	check("%s use_source_color = %s" % [path.get_file(), expected_bool],
		b != null and bool(b) == expected_bool, b)

func check_night_material() -> void:
	var mat: ShaderMaterial = load(NIGHT_MAT)
	check("material loads: %s" % NIGHT_MAT.get_file(), mat != null, mat)
	if mat == null:
		return
	check("%s uses night_skip.gdshader" % NIGHT_MAT.get_file(),
		mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == NIGHT_SHADER, mat.shader)
	# Night-skip material must not override any uniform; the three defaults live in the shader source.
	for p in NIGHT_UNIFORMS:
		var set_value: Variant = mat.get_shader_parameter(p)
		check("%s does not override %s (driver/material defaults apply)" % [NIGHT_MAT.get_file(), p],
			set_value == null, set_value)

func _check_texture_param(mat: ShaderMaterial, param: StringName, want: String, mat_path: String) -> void:
	var tex: Texture2D = mat.get_shader_parameter(param)
	check("%s binds %s to %s" % [mat_path.get_file(), param, want.get_file()],
		tex != null and tex.resource_path == want, tex.resource_path if tex else "null")

# ---- .import files ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func check_import(path: String, want: Dictionary) -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	var err := cfg.load(path + ".import")
	check("import readable: %s.import" % path.get_file(), err == OK, err)
	if err != OK:
		return

## A6 Effect A configuration read-back (CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3, §A.4).
## Loads res://effects/footstep_scuff.tscn and asserts every setting the brief names, using the
## brief's values as the expected values. No rendering, no triggering — the look is checked by
## frame strips; this test proves the scene file matches §A.3.
## Run:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_footstep_scuff_config.gd 60

const SCENE := "res://effects/footstep_scuff.tscn"

const EPS := 1.0e-5

func run() -> bool:
	var ps: PackedScene = load(SCENE)
	check("scene loads: %s" % SCENE, ps != null, ps)
	if ps == null:
		return true
	var root_node: Node = ps.instantiate()
	check("root is Node3D named FootstepScuff",
		root_node is Node3D and root_node.name == "FootstepScuff",
		"%s / %s" % [root_node.get_class(), root_node.name])
	check("root process_mode = PAUSABLE (1)",
		root_node.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE, root_node.process_mode)
	check("root has exactly two children (SoftDust, FineGrit)",
		root_node.get_child_count() == 2, root_node.get_child_count())

	var soft: CPUParticles3D = root_node.get_node_or_null("SoftDust")
	var grit: CPUParticles3D = root_node.get_node_or_null("FineGrit")
	check("SoftDust exists and is CPUParticles3D", soft != null, soft)
	check("FineGrit exists and is CPUParticles3D", grit != null, grit)
	if soft == null or grit == null:
		root_node.queue_free()
		return true

	_check_emitter(soft, "SoftDust", {
		"amount": 10, "lifetime": 1.15, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0,
		"box": Vector3(0.08, 0.01, 0.05),
		"spread": 80.0, "vmin": 0.25, "vmax": 0.65,
		"gravity_y": -0.9, "dmin": 1.5, "dmax": 2.5,
		"smin": 0.8, "smax": 1.2,
		"avmin": -40.0, "avmax": 40.0,
		"quad_size": Vector2(0.12, 0.12),
	})
	_check_emitter(grit, "FineGrit", {
		"amount": 5, "lifetime": 1.15, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0,
		"box": Vector3(0.06, 0.01, 0.04),
		"spread": 85.0, "vmin": 0.35, "vmax": 0.80,
		"gravity_y": -1.8, "dmin": 1.0, "dmax": 2.0,
		"smin": 0.7, "smax": 1.3,
		"avmin": -60.0, "avmax": 60.0,
		"quad_size": Vector2(0.035, 0.035),
	})

	# SoftDust size curve: 0.6 → 1.3 at 25% → 1.0 at 50% → 0.4 at end; max_value must clear 1.3 (§A.3 note).
	_check_scale_curve(soft, "SoftDust", [
		Vector2(0.0, 0.6), Vector2(0.25, 1.3), Vector2(0.5, 1.0), Vector2(1.0, 0.4),
	], 1.3)
	# FineGrit size curve: 1.0 → 0.9 at 50% → 0.2 at end.
	_check_scale_curve(grit, "FineGrit", [
		Vector2(0.0, 1.0), Vector2(0.5, 0.9), Vector2(1.0, 0.2),
	], 1.0)

	# SoftDust colour ramp (colour, alpha) from §A.3.
	_check_color_ramp(soft, "SoftDust", [
		[0.0,  Color8(0xD9, 0xC5, 0xA4), 0.55],
		[0.2,  Color8(0xE2, 0xD1, 0xB5), 0.45],

		[0.7,  Color8(0xE5, 0xD8, 0xC5), 0.00],
		[1.0,  Color8(0xE5, 0xD8, 0xC5), 0.00],
	])
	_check_color_ramp(grit, "FineGrit", [

		[0.3,  Color8(0xA1, 0x83, 0x5B), 0.65],
		[0.65, Color8(0xB8, 0x9A, 0x71), 0.15],
		[1.0,  Color8(0xB8, 0x9A, 0x71), 0.00],
	])

	root_node.queue_free()
	await steps(1)
	return true

func _check_emitter(cp: CPUParticles3D, name: String, want: Dictionary) -> void:
	check("%s emission_shape = EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX (3)" % name,
		cp.emission_shape == CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX, cp.emission_shape)
	check("%s amount = %d" % [name, want["amount"]], cp.amount == want["amount"], cp.amount)
	check("%s lifetime = %.2fs" % [name, want["lifetime"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.lifetime, want["lifetime"]), cp.lifetime)
	check("%s one_shot = %s" % [name, want["one_shot"]], cp.one_shot == want["one_shot"], cp.one_shot)
	check("%s explosiveness = %.2f" % [name, want["explosiveness"]],

	check("%s emitting = false (initial)" % name, cp.emitting == false, cp.emitting)
	check("%s emission_box_extents = %s" % [name, want["box"]],
		cp.emission_box_extents.is_equal_approx(want["box"]), cp.emission_box_extents)

	check("%s direction = (0, 1, 0)" % name,
		cp.direction.is_equal_approx(Vector3(0, 1, 0)), cp.direction)
	check("%s spread = %.0f deg" % [name, want["spread"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.spread, want["spread"]), cp.spread)
	check("%s initial_velocity_min = %.2f m/s" % [name, want["vmin"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.initial_velocity_min, want["vmin"]), cp.initial_velocity_min)
	check("%s initial_velocity_max = %.2f m/s" % [name, want["vmax"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.initial_velocity_max, want["vmax"]), cp.initial_velocity_max)
	check("%s gravity = (0, %.2f, 0)" % [name, want["gravity_y"]],
		cp.gravity.is_equal_approx(Vector3(0, want["gravity_y"], 0)), cp.gravity)
	check("%s damping_min = %.2f" % [name, want["dmin"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.damping_min, want["dmin"]), cp.damping_min)
	check("%s damping_max = %.2f" % [name, want["dmax"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.damping_max, want["dmax"]), cp.damping_max)
	check("%s scale_amount_min = %.2f" % [name, want["smin"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.scale_amount_min, want["smin"]), cp.scale_amount_min)
	check("%s scale_amount_max = %.2f" % [name, want["smax"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.scale_amount_max, want["smax"]), cp.scale_amount_max)
	check("%s hue_variation_min = -0.02" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.hue_variation_min, -0.02), cp.hue_variation_min)
	check("%s hue_variation_max = +0.02" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.hue_variation_max, 0.02), cp.hue_variation_max)
	check("%s angle_min = 0 deg" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.angle_min, 0.0), cp.angle_min)
	check("%s angle_max = 360 deg" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.angle_max, 360.0), cp.angle_max)
	check("%s angular_velocity_min = %.0f deg/s" % [name, want["avmin"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.angular_velocity_min, want["avmin"]), cp.angular_velocity_min)
	check("%s angular_velocity_max = %.0f deg/s" % [name, want["avmax"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.angular_velocity_max, want["avmax"]), cp.angular_velocity_max)

	# Draw
	var mesh := cp.mesh as QuadMesh
	check("%s mesh is QuadMesh" % name, mesh != null, cp.mesh)
	if mesh != null:
		check("%s quad size = %s m" % [name, want["quad_size"]],
			mesh.size.is_equal_approx(want["quad_size"]), mesh.size)
		var mat := mesh.material as StandardMaterial3D
		check("%s material is StandardMaterial3D" % name, mat != null, mesh.material)
		if mat != null:
			check("%s material.transparency = ALPHA (1)" % name,
				mat.transparency == BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA, mat.transparency)
			check("%s material.blend_mode = MIX (0)" % name,
				mat.blend_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_MIX, mat.blend_mode)
			check("%s material.shading_mode = UNSHADED (0)" % name,
				mat.shading_mode == BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED, mat.shading_mode)
			check("%s material.billboard_mode = BILLBOARD_PARTICLES (3)" % name,
				mat.billboard_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES, mat.billboard_mode)
			check("%s material.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true" % name,
				mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo == true, mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo)
			check("%s material.albedo_texture is a procedural GradientTexture2D" % name,
				mat.albedo_texture != null and mat.albedo_texture is GradientTexture2D, mat.albedo_texture)

	check("%s local_coords = false (dust stays at footprint)" % name,
		cp.local_coords == false, cp.local_coords)
	check("%s preprocess = 0.0 s" % name, is_equal_approx(cp.preprocess, 0.0), cp.preprocess)
	check("%s speed_scale = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(cp.speed_scale, 1.0), cp.speed_scale)
	check("%s visibility_aabb = AABB((-0.6,-0.1,-0.6),(1.2,0.6,1.2))" % name,

		cp.visibility_aabb)
